scope: Home window instant hide for screenshot, realtime subtitles, and audio subtitles
changes: home renderer adds body.pre-hide (opacity 0) synchronously on pointerdown before IPC
main minimizes home with setSkipTaskbar(true) before hide and restores taskbar on show
startup fallback show timer is cleared on ready-to-show/closed and guarded by session activity
ready-to-show, startup timer, and window:focus no longer re-show the home while selecting/realtime/audio is active
root_cause: Cold packaged startup could fire a show path after the home was hidden for selection: the ready-to-show handler and startup fallback timer called show() unconditionally, and hover focus (window:focus) could show a hidden home. The home briefly reappeared over the frozen capture background.
runs_note: Three cold packaged runs: home hidden 6–10 ms; screenshot overlay visible 220–242 ms; realtime overlay visible 185–191 ms. Home stayed hidden at +1.8 s and after a window:focus ping in every run.
